## Key finding (drives the whole implementation)
The frozen §12/§13 schema ALREADY expresses every P17.1 construct — no schema change.
This ticket is the **standing proof of §5.2**: populate/express the Stage-5 pathways with the
committed ontology and prove it via the generalization conformance suite. Homes:
- Tests: `tests/ontology/generalization/` (existing suite `test_generalization.py` already has
  `test_integration_hub_consuming_other_systems`, `test_reference_database_as_infrastructure`,
  `test_commercial_data_access_relationship_with_no_local_sensor`). Add a deeper Stage-5 module.
- Model: generated Pydantic `ontology/generated/pydantic/sig_models.py` via `support.load_generated_pydantic`.
- Vocab: `ontology/vocab/technology.yaml` already has `rtcc-platform`, `camera-federation-hub`,
  `third-party-investigative-platform`, `person-records-broker`, `adtech-location-purchase`.
- Schema classes: RoleAssignment(role/party/over), IntegrationEdge(data_kind + consent_gate...),
  AccessRelationship(scope/direction/automaticity/access_kind), DataSystem, PhysicalAsset, Organization.
- `integrates_with` deliberately absent from EdgeType (asserted by test_schema_structure.py::test_prohibited_edges_are_absent).

## Requirements to satisfy / stamp
SIG-CHART-027, SIG-CHART-028, SIG-ONTO-045, SIG-ONTO-046, SIG-ONTO-047, SIG-ONTO-048, SIG-ONTO-031
plus entity/vocab ids (§11.7 Deployment SIG-ONTO-026, §11.8 PhysicalAsset SIG-ONTO-027, §11.10 DataSystem SIG-ONTO-031, §13.1 vocab slugs).

## Acceptance criteria (from ticket)
1. Private-camera federation + RTCC integration populated w/ NO schema change; generalization suite passes; required change → Phase-1 defect (SIG-CHART-027/028). deterministic
2. Commercial data-broker chain representable w/ distinct aggregator & productizer roles — six-layer chain, resells_data_from between separate broker & productizing-platform orgs (SIG-ONTO-046, App D.5 pathway 3). deterministic
3. Integration hubs consuming other systems as directional edges (no stored integrates_with); private-camera owner≠operator independently representable (SIG-ONTO-045/047/048). deterministic
4. Phase-gate §51.3: CI green incl data-quality; new reqs tested (SIG-ENG-004); ADRs for any deviation; traceability updated; risk-register updated.

## Cross-cutting invariants
- No schema/ontology change (P01.1 owns LinkML; verify-gen must stay byte-clean).
- Additive/back-compat; append-only/provenance not touched (test-only + docs).
- No plate/trip/per-person; no asset→person edge (Part VIII).

## Test matrix (Phase 1.4)
- AC3/AC1 pathway1: owner≠operator via two RoleAssignments over one private Camera asset; enrolls_asset_into
  (device object) is a distinct edge from a live-feed ingests_feed_from IntegrationEdge carrying its own consent_gate;
  federates_search_to platform→RTCC; participates_in dept→fusion center. (SIG-ONTO-047/048/045/046)
- AC3: RTCC hub as DataSystem consuming other systems via ingests_feed_from / federates_search_to / pushes_alerts_to;
  assert integrates_with not in EdgeType; reference DB as DataSystem w/ no sensor (SIG-ONTO-031).
- AC2: six-layer broker chain subscribes_to→resells_data_from→resells_data_from across 6 DISTINCT orgs;
  aggregator (broker) ≠ productizer (investigative platform); assert reduction to shares_with impossible.
- AC1/defect-path: assert every EdgeType/Role/technology-slug/entity-class used by the pathways already
  exists in the committed ontology → population needed NO schema change (the Phase-1-defect detector).
